claims.text: Circle and Coinbase's USDC revenue-sharing Collaboration Agreement (originally effective 2023-08-18) entered an additional three-year renewal term on 2026-08-18. Multiple secondary reports (KuCoin, Crypto.news, CoinGape, Cryptobriefing, CoinGabbar, cryptonews.net) state the renewal preserves the original 2023 economics unchanged through 2029 — Coinbase retains 100% of USDC reserve interest income held on its own platform and roughly 50% of residual reserve income on USDC held elsewhere — citing Coinbase CFO Alesia Haas's 2026-07-30 Q2 earnings-call statement and Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire's 2026-08-05 Q2 earnings-call statement.
claims.note: 그레이드3 다중 매체 교차확인이나 단독 판단 근거 불가(P4) — confirmed=false 유지. 100%/50% 분배 비율 자체는 2023년 원 계약 조항(반복 인용)이며 2026 신규 수치 아님.

claims.text: CryptoSlate reports that the Collaboration Agreement's enforcement provisions include a 'Product Threshold Remedy' (Circle may exclude the 'Party Product Economics Amount' after a 60-day cure period following written notice of a minimum blockchain/Layer-2/product-support or discoverability failure, escalating on a third failure within 12 months) and a 'Reseller Threshold Remedy' (Circle may exclude the 'Ecosystem Economics Amount' after a 90-day cure period if users cannot buy/sell USDC for dollars on Coinbase in relevant jurisdictions); the article attributes these terms to an SEC-filed exhibit of the original agreement, not a new 2026 filing.
claims.note: 단일 그레이드3 소스 — 원본 SEC exhibit을 직접 대조하지 못함(1차 URL 역추적 실패). confirmed=false.

claims.text: A single report (CoinReporter, 2026-08-19) describes the 2026-08-18/19 renewal as an 'expansion' in which Coinbase gains more favorable USDC reserve-income economics in exchange for deeper integration commitments across Coinbase Pay, the Base network, and the main exchange — a characterization that conflicts with the 'unchanged terms' reporting in claim c_20260820_COIN_002 (five other outlets).
claims.note: coinreporter.io는 sources.yaml 미등재 도메인(default_grade=4). 단독 소스, 그레이드1·2 뒷받침 없음, 8-K 부재(c_001)와 상충 가능 — 진위 미확정.

claims.text: Given single-source grade-4 sourcing for the 'expanded/more favorable economics' narrative versus broader multi-outlet grade-3 corroboration (anchored to two executives' direct earnings-call statements) for 'unchanged terms,' and given no 8-K or other grade-1/2 filing disclosing amended terms, the 'unchanged terms' characterization is currently better supported; the 'expansion' report may be conflating separate OUSD-integration commitments with the Circle-Coinbase renewal itself.
claims.note: 판정이 아니라 상충 서사에 대한 확신도 평가 — 최종 확정은 사람(신규 8-K 또는 10-Q 계약 주석 확인 시까지 잠정).

claims.text: Deribit (Coinbase's international derivatives exchange subsidiary) plans to launch USDC-settled, up-to-50x-leverage RWA perpetual contracts on US equities/ETFs/commodities/pre-IPO assets starting 2026-08-31 (initial listings: NVDA, MSFT, META, TSLA, AAPL, GOOGL, AMZN, plus QQQ/SPY ETFs), phasing in additional names through early September (incl. AMD, HOOD, INTC, MRVL, TSM, MSTR, CRCL equities; GOLD/SILVER/BRENTOIL/WTIOIL commodities; pre-IPO OPENAI/ANTHROPIC contracts before the cutover), with full migration of Coinbase International Exchange (INTX) derivatives trading to a Deribit-powered 'Starbase' matching engine completing 2026-09-09, targeting 125+ perpetual contracts.
claims.note: 1차 소스 support.deribit.com 직접 접근 403 차단(역추적 실패) — confirmed=false 유지. coingape.com·cryptotimes.io 모두 sources.yaml 미등재(default grade4), 상호 교차확인은 되나 단독 판단 근거 불가(P4). 매출·거래량 기여치는 미공시.
